Meet Dana

The artist
behind the set

I've been doing nails for about three years, and 2024 marked my first year taking it on professionally. I recently signed my own lease, so every client now gets a full consult before we start — shape, length, color, art — because a good set is a set that fits your hands and your life.

I work out of a private, sanitary space and only book one client at a time. No rushing, no overlap. Come in, get pampered, leave with nails you'll photograph.

— Dana
